predecessors.name: New Hebrides
predecessors.text: the whole archipelago, the Anglo-French Condominium of the New Hebrides: 'The New Hebrides, now renamed Vanuatu, achieved independence as planned on 30 July 1980'

ledger.x: 1980: the New Hebrides become the independent Republic of Vanuatu.
1980: Espiritu Santo is held by secessionists as Vanuatu becomes independent.

wars.name: Coconut War
wars.outcome: Government victory: the Nagriamel secession on Espiritu Santo, which lasted 'about 12 weeks', ended with Stevens's surrender on 28 August 1980; the infobox lists a 'Vanuatuan, Papua New Guinean and Solomon Islander victory'.

certainty.note: Island coasts; maritime limits are not drawn.
